# Test fixture provenance

All fixtures in this directory are synthetic and generated by the test suite or the local fixture generator. They contain no customer, vendor, or third-party CAD content and are safe to regenerate. No external license or redistribution permission is required.

The binary DWG files under `testfiles/` are retained legacy regression samples. Their provenance and redistribution authorization have not been independently verified; they are used only when present in a local checkout and are not copied into package artifacts.
